title.hr: DNS: sekundarni poslužitelj i istek zone
title.en: DNS: the secondary and zone expiry

concept.hr: Sekundarni je predmemorija s rokom: mrtvi primarni obori zonu, samo kasnije
concept.en: A secondary is a cache with a timer: a dead primary takes the zone down later

summary.hr: SOA serijski broj, osvježavanje, ponovni pokušaj i istek. Isključi primarni i pusti vrijeme: sekundarni odgovara iz kopije dok mu ne istekne rok, pa SERVFAIL.
summary.en: SOA serial, refresh, retry and expire. Switch the primary off and let time run: the secondary answers from its copy until its timer runs out, then SERVFAIL.
